thread:
kenji: Quick heads-up — I opened a PR that hoists provider blocks out of our internal modules and swaps a couple of in-repo modules for registry equivalents (db-connector, s3-writer). Need a quick check on provider pinning + lockfile handling before I merge: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/492

marta: Nice. Do you have a summary of the pin strategy? We can't migrate everything to v4 yet for reasons on the mysql connector.

kenji: Summary: root `providers.tf` pins `aws = "~> 3.5"` and `hashicorp/null = ">= 3.0, <4.0"` (we still want to avoid v4 for null). Modules no longer define provider blocks (hoisted) and use implicit provider from root. For registry modules I kept versions explicit, e.g. `registry.module/db-connector = "1.2.0"`.

alex: Can you paste the local `terraform plan` output and the `terraform providers lock` snippet? Also did you run `terraform init -reconfigure` after hoist?

kenji: Ran `init -reconfigure` and `terraform providers lock -platform=linux_amd64`. Plan looked clean locally. Paste below: 

```
$ terraform init -reconfigure
Reinitialized existing state with modified backend configuration.
$ terraform plan
Plan: 0 to add, 0 to change, 0 to destroy.
$ terraform providers lock -platform=linux_amd64
Creating dependency lock file .terraform.lock.hcl
- registry.terraform.io/hashicorp/aws 3.68.0
- registry.terraform.io/hashicorp/null 3.2.1
```

marta: Cool. Two quick asks: 1) Make sure the lockfile is committed to the PR (CI will validate it). 2) Add a note to the infra changelog about the provider hoist and the reason we kept null <4.0.

kenji: Yep — lockfile included in the PR and added a short changelog entry under `docs/infra/CHANGELOG.md`. CI just ran and passed.

devops-bot: deploy-bot: terraform plan for branch infra/refactor/provider-hoist completed in 22s — no infrastructure drift detected.

alex: Looks good to me. A couple of nits in the PR comments but nothing blocking.

marta: LGTM as long as CI passes and the lockfile is present (we want deterministic provider checks for Dedicated). :+1:

kenji: Thanks — will merge in ~5m after a final green, and monitor staging for any provider init warnings. Tagging @alex for follow-up if we see any surprises.

alex: ack, will keep an eye on the staging plan output.

kenji: Merged. Will leave the branch around for a day in case we need to revert.
